queries.sql: SELECT tb1.* , tb3.title , tb2.group_id , tb4.* , tb5.lang_code FROM bmc_1.bmc_users tb1 INNER JOIN bmc_1.bmc_user_usergroup_map tb2 ON tb2.user_id = tb1.id INNER JOIN bmc_1.bmc_usergroups tb3 ON tb3.id = tb2.group_id LEFT JOIN bmc_user_profile_custom tb4 ON tb4.user_id = tb1.id LEFT JOIN bmc_language_type tb5 ON tb5.id = tb4.lang_id WHERE tb1.id = '967' LIMIT 1
